_comment: Title engineering rules. On valueaddvc.com, rewriting titles on pages that rank for HUMAN queries but under-earn clicks outgrew a matched control by ~20-38 points (docs/playbook/02-measurement.md). The CTR benchmarks below are illustrative heuristics, not measurements; fit your own curve from GSC (lib/ctr.mjs). Retitle only pages that scripts/human-query-split.mjs flags.
rules: Start every title with the most specific, surprising number from the content
Keep total length under 60 characters (Google truncates at ~60)
Use dash separator between number hook and topic
The number should create curiosity or signal authority
Apply the same number-first pattern to meta descriptions

steps: Find the most compelling number in each page's content body
Rewrite: move number to position 1, update meta description to match

Deploy; the sitemap's accurate lastmod plus internal links from crawled hubs get it recrawled. For a handful of urgent URLs, use Search Console URL Inspection > Request indexing (the Indexing API is only for JobPosting/livestream pages).
Measure: compare CTR at same position band (use rewrite-measurer.mjs)

examples.after: $347B in Q1 — Market Exit Window Dashboard
